issues.title: Crash on markdown-heavy reply
issues.detail: Same source id (csapp-iss-1001) as issues-manifest-baseline-valid.json, but reporterRef and occurredAt differ — this is the IMPORT_RECORD_CONFLICT scenario (same source ID, incompatible identity data) an ImportPreview.conflictingRecords entry MUST surface when compared against the already-imported record; the manifest itself is structurally valid, the conflict is a cross-import comparison Core performs, not a schema violation.
